objective: Each of seven MPC nodes independently checks its exact executed fill against the configured canonical DeFMI service before advancing its secret book; the existing native corporate wallet/reuse journey still completes.
hard_constraints: All seven actual nodes reject an unsubmitted finality assertion and the later true but not independently observed assertion; status remains unchanged after each rejection.
All seven actual nodes reject a fill with altered parent bytes against the real accepted transaction; status remains unchanged.
Each node uses its own read-only mTLS identity and operator-configured endpoint. No caller-selected endpoint or claimed receipt is accepted.

Signed local round/slot/output/pair, full committee-signed fill, canonical statement/parent/after-root/transaction/block/height are checked before an atomic persistent observation. Exact observation repeat changes no state or signing nonce.

All matched slots must have observations before the round advances. The whole lab scenario has one fill; multi-fill coverage is separately deterministic unit evidence, not an executed multi-fill claim.

Original 40-at-100 trade, three claim redemptions/repeats, facility witnesses 2/2, exact refund-funded next order and seven admissions with facility 2/3 must still pass, then five equal roots and an actual validator restart.
No local compilation, tests or Docker. Use Softbank or Omen. No participant signature after matching to authorize the original settlement.
truth_provider: Node-local signed MPC sidecars and persistent observations, read-only mTLS canonical txStatus RPC, exact signed zkPI and five live Avalanche validators, corporate proof-serial checks.
non_claims: The configured DeFMI read service remains a trust boundary, not a validator light-client proof or independent operator deployment.
Retrospective proof verification uses the signed deadline as an in-range anchor, not a claimed block timestamp; the actual VM enforces execution-time validity.
No second match, native multi-fill/cancellation/expiry acceptance, WAN/performance/economic confirmation, product/UI acceptance, HSM/HA or cryptographic audit.
V7 finalized private heads are rejected until explicit canonical reconciliation; no old store is erased or silently trusted.
